hot_open_shortlist.cysteine_handle: Catalytic Cys450 (triad Cys450/His862/Asp895) — the same active-site nucleophile class that has yielded cyanopyrrolidine/cyanimide covalent DUB inhibitors (USP30, USP32-Huib32, USP7). Selectivity is the live risk since USP active sites are conserved and USP35 is a promiscuous chain-cleaver, so allosteric/steric covalent designs are likely needed.
hot_open_shortlist.driver: Ferroptosis regulation (USP35 stabilizes ferroportin), plus cancer metabolic reprogramming and immune escape via STING/ID3 deubiquitination.
hot_open_shortlist.why_now: 2025-26 surge across gastric (Cell Death & Dis 2025), colorectal ID3/immune escape (Adv Sci 2026), HCC/prostate/ovarian/lung — yet no dedicated USP35 probe, program, or patent has surfaced and only ~6 of ~100 DUBs have quality inhibitors, leaving the active-site covalent lane genuinely open.

emerging_contested: ACSL4 — covalent Cys170 (rociletinib acrylamide, Cell Chem Biol 2025) already contested by AS-252424 + a fragment FBDD series (LIBX-A402/A403) converging 2024-26; dominant thesis is inhibition for cytoprotection
GSDMD — reactive Cys191 is a textbook covalent hotspot but already occupied: disulfiram (nM, Phase 2) plus NU6300, necrosulfonamide, DMF, GI-Y1/Y2 crowd the same cysteine

GFUS (TSTA3/FX) — catalytic Cys109/His179 dyad is tractable and the direct active-site covalent approach is relatively open, but salvage-pathway decoys (2-FF/SGN-2FF, 6-alkynyl-fucose) stake the field; clinical thromboembolism flag + SDR selectivity risk (medium confidence)
CPT1A — covalent Cys96 validated (DHP-B, Redox Biol 2023) but lane staked by that probe plus legacy etomoxir (hepatotoxicity) and 2025 HTS platforms; CPT1B/C selectivity and liver-tox overhang

SQOR — essential catalytic cysteine trisulfide (Cys201-S-S-S-Cys379) with 2019 X-ray enables covalent design, but the only chemical matter (STI1, 29 nM) is non-covalent/CoQ-competitive and aimed at heart failure; no covalent or ferroptosis-directed inhibitor yet (medium confidence)

FABP5 — pocket-bottom Cys43 already drugged covalently (Aurigene AUR104, MS-confirmed adduct) and Cys120 (MT-21); contested further by Artelo ART26.12 (selective FABP5 inhibitor, Phase 1) — clinically de-risked, covalent stake planted

NEK7 — reactive Cys79 at the NEK7-NLRP3 interface (rociletinib warhead, PoC published), but lane effectively closed/clinical: Halia HT-6184 (Ph2), Monte Rosa MRT-8102 glue (85% CRP reduction Ph1), Novartis + multiple CRBN degraders

USP11 — catalytic Cys318, the canonical covalent-DUB nucleophile, but already contested by a 2025 paralogue-selective covalent series (chloroacetyl pyrrole-carboxamide, jump-dilution confirmed, ~2.6 uM over USP4/15) plus mitoxantrone/IsoLiPro/HTS hits; early/academic, no clinic
noise_filtered: FER — WORD-COLLISION: signal_real=false; the 4540 hits and 496 'new_trials' are the 2021-26 ferroptosis/iron text-mining explosion ('Fer-1'=ferrostatin-1, 'fer/ferr'=ferritin/ferric/ferrous), not the niche FER tyrosine kinase (dozens of papers/yr); even the real gene has no covalent program
DOCK2 — NOT-TRACTABLE: real gene but surge is omics immune-infiltration marker usage; DHR-2 GEF/Rac interface has no exploitable cysteine, only reversible pan-DOCK CPYPP

HDGFL2 — NOT-TRACTABLE: real gene but surge is the HDGFL2-CE TDP-43 splicing biomarker (diagnostic, not a target); PWWP domain has one oxidation-prone solvent cysteine (Cys64) mutated out by structural teams

GBA1 — NOT-TRACTABLE/WRONG-DIRECTION: real GCase surge (Parkinson's genetics, clinical readouts) but thesis is ACTIVATE/chaperone; only covalent residue is catalytic Glu340 (glutamate), and probes there are irreversible inactivators
MS4A1 — NOT-TRACTABLE: real CD20 surge (CD20xCD3 bispecifics, CAR-T) but a 4-TM antigen with no small-molecule pocket; ECL2 cysteines form a structural disulfide; all 13+ programs are biologics

DLAT — NOT-TRACTABLE: real cuproptosis biology but His-Asp catalytic pair (no reactive cysteine); the actionable moiety is the lipoyl arm, and 'small molecules' (disulfiram/elesclomol) are upstream copper ionophores
ADGRE5 — NOT-TRACTABLE: real CD97 adhesion-GPCR surge but the epitope is the extracellular GAIN domain; every program is a biologic (ADC/nanobody/antibody), no cytoplasmic reactive cysteine

S100A10 — NOT-TRACTABLE: real p11/AnxA2 biology but a ~97-aa Ca-insensitive EF-hand PPI scaffold; only Cys61 is a solvent-exposed disulfide-former; all prior art reversible PPI disruption, depression thesis wants enhancement
PCLAF — NOT-TRACTABLE: real PAF15-PCNA Nature 2025 surge but a ~111-aa intrinsically disordered PIP-box protein with no fold/active site/cysteine; all pharmacology hits the partner PCNA (AOH1996)

MAEA — NOT-TRACTABLE/WRONG-DIRECTION: real CTLH/GID E3 biology but a non-canonical RING-L whose only cysteines are buried zinc-coordinating structural residues; GI-cancer role is tumor-suppressive (argues for boosting)

OXCT1 — NOT-TRACTABLE: real SCOT ketolysis/immunometabolism surge but catalytic nucleophile is Glu344 (glutamate), oxidative inactivation via Tyr/Trp nitration; no reactive cysteine; lane also contested by reversible inhibitors (pimozide, PSSI-51)
PGAM5 — NOT-TRACTABLE: real ferroptosis/cell-death node but a histidine-acid (2H-phosphatase) catalyzing through His105, not a thiol phosphatase; chemical matter (LFHP-1c) is reversible/non-covalent

GZMB — NOT-TRACTABLE/WRONG-CHEMISTRY: real granzyme B inflammaging/fibrosis surge but a SERINE protease (His-Asp-Ser triad); existing covalent inhibitors are serine-trap warheads on a conserved S1 site, no cysteine handle

MTCH2 — WEAK/NOT-TRACTABLE: real SLC25A50 insertase + ferroptosis surge but a membrane-buried hydrophilic conduction groove with no reported catalytic/reactive cysteine and no chemoproteomic flag; genetic validation only

ATOX1 — WEAK/NOT-TRACTABLE: real cuproptosis copper-chaperone surge with reactive CXXC cysteines (Cys12/15) but those are generic to the whole HMA metallochaperone family (CCS, ATP7A/B), so selectivity fails; only ligand (DC_AC50) binds the PPI interface, not the cysteines
thematic_clusters: Ferroptosis is the dominant engine — recurring across ACSL4 (PUFA esterification), FABP5 (PUFA funneling/GPX4 suppression), CPT1A (FAO-driven resistance), SQOR (GPX4-independent suppressor), MTCH2, PGAM5, USP11 and USP35 (ferroportin); even the FER false-positive rides 'Fer-1' ferroptosis vocabulary
Cuproptosis / copper-dependent death — DLAT (lipoylated E2 + Cu+ oligomerization) and ATOX1 (copper chaperone), plus a large wave of pan-cancer prognostic copper-signature bioinformatics
NLRP3 inflammasome / pyroptosis — GSDMD (pore-forming executioner, NET formation in sepsis) and NEK7 (obligate licensing factor); cardiovascular/residual-inflammatory-risk framing
Immuno-oncology & immunometabolism — CPT1A and OXCT1 (T-cell exhaustion / TAM reprogramming), GFUS (afucosylated-antibody ADCC), DOCK2 (ICI-response marker)
Cysteine-protease DUB class as a covalent-native modality — USP11 (Cys318) and USP35 (Cys450), riding DNA-repair/HR plus ferroptosis/autophagy biology
Neurodegeneration & fluid biomarkers — HDGFL2-CE (TDP-43 ALS/FTD diagnostic), GBA1 (Parkinson's lysosomal), with gasdermin/PGAM5 neuro roles appearing as secondary drivers

Bioinformatics marker-gene inflation — a cross-cutting noise source: scRNA-seq/TCGA prognostic-signature usage inflates counts for DOCK2, DLAT and copper/ferroptosis signatures without genuine drug-discovery momentum
takeaway: The momentum protocol surfaced exactly one genuinely HOT_OPEN covalent lane — USP35, a real, accelerating, ferroptosis/immune-escape DUB with an unclaimed catalytic Cys450 — and even that carries only medium confidence (modest accel ~1.17, zero new trials, conserved-active-site selectivity risk). The signal-to-noise is sobering: of 24 verdicts, 15 were filtered as NOISE/WEAK, and the failure mode is almost entirely 'real gene, wrong chemistry' (13 of 15) rather than true word-collisions — FER is the lone acronym artifact (Fer-1/ferritin), confirming the gene-name dedup is working but that biological-momentum signals get swamped by undruggable-for-covalent targets (membrane antigens, IDPs, His/Ser/Glu-catalysis enzymes, metallochaperones) and by omics marker-gene inflation. The 8 EMERGING_CONTESTED targets validate the underlying biology themes (ferroptosis above all) but every one already has a covalent stake or a clinical degrader/allosteric program planted, so they are de-risking reads rather than whitespace. Honest read: the protocol is good at finding hot emerging biology and good at killing non-tractable targets, but truly open hot covalent lanes are rare — here, one defensible shortlist entry, and the real value is the candid contested/noise triage that tells Axiom where not to spend.
